description: The pie chart, titled "Categories," displays the distribution of different categories based on their respective counts and percentages. The largest segment, colored red, represents "chat" with a count of 546,526, accounting for 41.2% of the total. The second largest segment, in blue, corresponds to "math" with 290,496 instances, making up 21.9%. The green segment, labeled "tooluse," shows 154,358 instances, contributing 11.6%. The orange segment, "multi turn chat," has 123,615 instances and represents 9.3% of the total. The purple segment, "code," accounts for 119,563 instances, or 9.0%. The smallest segment, in pink, is "instruction follow" with 91,460 instances, representing 6.9%. A legend on the left side of the chart provides a key for the categories, associating each color with its label and count. Each slice of the pie chart is labeled with its category name and percentage value.
